NOUGHTVAULT  //  MOTIF · PUCUK REBUNG

Pucuk rebung

The bamboo shoot — the border motif of the Malay archipelago, and the only traditional one that is already austere enough for a void-black brand. 25.5 × 68 mm on the 350 mm print. Three nested outlines are the canting convention; the spine of slashed noughts is ours. Each nought is sized from the shoot’s own half-width at its height, so it can never overflow the outline.
